sloka: हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु दितिः परम दुःखिता ।मारीचम् काश्यपम् राम भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-४६-१॥
transliteration: hateṣu teṣu putreṣu ditiḥ parama duḥkhitā ।mārīcam kāśyapam rāma bhartāram idam abravīt ॥1-46-1॥

translations.english: "O Rama! afflicted with great grief when her sons were killed, Diti said to her husband Kasyapa, son of Maricha:
